01 / Mental models: nghĩ theo ý, không dịch từng từ

3 nguyên tắc: chọn mental model → nhớ cả cụm → luyện trong ngữ cảnh thật.

01

See the situation

Hãy hình dung “bên trong một việc”, “trên một nền tảng”, “tại một mốc” thay vì dịch từ tiếng Việt.

02

Learn chunks

Nhớ nguyên cụm: in production · on a call · work on an issue · in progress.

03

Speak in 3 steps

What I see → What it means → What I suggest. Rất hữu ích khi nói với PMO hoặc GM.

3 mental models cho mọi cuộc trò chuyện

Social: Notice → Share → Ask

Nhận xét một điều quanh mình → kể một trải nghiệm cá nhân → hỏi một câu mở.

“The rain was heavy yesterday. My ride home took longer. How was yours?”
Technical: Fact → Impact → Next step

Điều đã xác nhận → ảnh hưởng → bước cần làm. Không sa vào log khi nói với GM.

“The PR check is optional. It won’t block a merge. Let’s review the branch policy.”
Course: Main idea → Difference → Example

Nghe từ khóa → nói lại theo cách đơn giản → cho ví dụ IT thực tế.

“Routes choose the path. Firewall rules control access. A reachable VM can still be unsafe.”
Phân biệt cấp độ chắc chắn: “We confirmed...” (đã xác nhận) · “The logs suggest...” (bằng chứng gợi ý) · “The likely cause is...” (khả năng cao) · “We haven’t confirmed it yet.” (chưa kết luận).

V3 — Khi đang nói, chọn mục đích trước

Không nghe đượcCould you say that again?
Chưa hiểu ýCould you give me an example?
Chưa xác minhIt looks like... · Apparently...
Có bằng chứngThe logs show... · We’ve confirmed...
Trải nghiệm đến nayHave you tried...? · I’ve never...
Review PRComment on the PR · code in the PR

02 / IN vs ON, thêm AT & BY

Mental models và cặp câu dễ nhầm trong cuộc sống, họp Teams, Azure, CI/CD và incident.

IN
Inside / context

in the room · in a meeting · in the logs · in production · in October

ON
Surface / platform / activity

on the table · on Teams · on a call · on Azure · work on a task

AT
Point / exact location or time

at 3 PM · at the office · at lunch · at the meeting

BY
Agent / method / deadline

by accident · by email · by Friday · written by the team

Bảng cặp câu — học như một chuỗi

IN phraseÝ chínhON phraseÝ chính
SPACE / LOCATION
in the officeở bên trong văn phòngon the deskở trên mặt bàn
in the carbên trong ô tôon the busđi xe buýt (phương tiện công cộng)
in the picturetrong nội dung ảnhon the screenhiển thị trên màn hình
in the citytrong phạm vi thành phốon the streettrên đường phố
in the queue (UK)đứng trong hàngon the listcó tên trong danh sách
WORK / SYSTEMS
in productiontrong môi trường PRODon Azuretrên nền tảng Azure
in the logstrong nội dung logon the dashboardhiển thị trên dashboard
in the codetrong nội dung codeon line 126tại dòng 126
in the PR descriptiontrong nội dung mô tả PRon the PR pagetrên trang PR
in the databasetrong DBon the SQL servertrên máy chủ SQL
in the Teams channeltrong kênh Teamson Teamsqua nền tảng Teams
in the documenttrong nội dung tài liệuon the websitetrên trang web
in a meetingđang ở trong cuộc họpon a callđang trong cuộc gọi
in progressđang tiến hànhwork on a tasklàm một nhiệm vụ
in a project (context)trong phạm vi dự ánwork on a projectđang làm dự án
TIME / EVENT
in Octobertrong tháng Mườion Mondayvào thứ Hai
in 2026trong năm 2026on October 25vào ngày 25 tháng Mười
in the morningvào buổi sáng nói chungon Monday morningvào sáng thứ Hai
in timekịp lúc / trước khi muộnon timeđúng lịch / đúng giờ
in the accidenttrong vụ tai nạnon the highwaytrên đường cao tốc
in troubleđang gặp rắc rốion leaveđang nghỉ phép

Accident: phân biệt 4 cách dùng

I was in an accident. — Tôi có liên quan trong vụ tai nạn.

There was an accident on the highway. — Tai nạn xảy ra trên cao tốc.

It happened by accident. — Việc đó xảy ra vô tình.

I read a report on the accident. — Tôi đọc báo cáo về vụ tai nạn.

“On accident” xuất hiện trong tiếng Anh Mỹ thân mật của một số người; ưu tiên by accident khi giao tiếp quốc tế.

4 câu cần thuộc cho công việc

We had an issue in production on Friday.

I saw an error in the logs on the server.

I posted the details in the Teams channel.

We’re working on a fix right now.

Cách ghi nhớ: environment → in; content → in; platform/server → on; activity → on.

Đừng bỏ qua những cặp dễ sai khác

ON TIME vs IN TIME

on time = đúng giờ; in time = kịp trước khi trễ.

“We started on time. I joined just in time.”
IN a meeting vs AT a meeting

in a meeting = đang trong cuộc họp / quá trình họp; at a meeting = tại sự kiện họp, cả hai có thể đúng.

“We discussed it at/in the meeting.”
IN Teams vs ON Teams

in Teams = bên trong ứng dụng/kênh; on Teams = dùng nền tảng Teams.

“It’s in the Teams channel. Let’s talk on Teams.”
FOR vs SINCE

for five years = kéo dài 5 năm; since 2021 = từ mốc 2021.

“He’s lived here for five years.”
BY vs UNTIL

by Friday = xong muộn nhất vào thứ Sáu; until Friday = tiếp diễn tới thứ Sáu.

“Send it by Friday. I’m away until Friday.”
INTO vs ONTO

into = chuyển vào bên trong; onto = chuyển lên một bề mặt/nền tảng.

“Write data into the DB. Deploy onto a server.”
Mental model giúp đoán nhanh, nhưng cụm cố định (collocations) vẫn quan trọng: on a call, in progress, on leave, in trouble, by accident. Học luôn cả cụm.

03 / PR comments & giới từ trong công việc

Câu trả lời nhanh: one unresolved comment on the PR là tự nhiên; in the PR khi nói code và nội dung.

IN

Contents / inside

in the PR · in the code · in production · in the logs · in a meeting

ON

Review / host / surface

on the PR · on line 126 · on Azure · on a call · on Monday

AT / BY

Point / deadline / method

at 3 PM · at the office · by Friday · by accident

One PR, two viewpoints

PULL REQUEST #2418 Review surface
💬 Comment ON the PR Unresolved · please review
Changes IN the PRsrc/OrderService.cspipelines/build.ymlREADME.md
Review/comment ONGắn trên đối tượng PRCode/change INChứa trong PRKhông tuyệt đối“Issue on/in the PR” có khi đều nghe được, tuỳ bạn muốn nhấn nội dung hay review.

“There’s one unresolved comment on your PR. Could you check it before merging?”

26 everyday + workplace contrasts

Tình huốngCâu tự nhiênMental model
Comment/reviewThere is one unresolved comment on the PR.Comment gắn với PR/review surface.
Code/changesThere is a potential bug in this PR.Lỗi nằm trong nội dung code/changes của PR.
Chi tiết phần mô tảI added the test steps in the PR description.Một phần cụ thể bên trong PR.
ReviewCould you leave your feedback on the PR?Hoạt động review của PR.
ChangeThe fix is included in this PR.Change là một phần nội dung PR.
Comment threadI replied in the comment thread.Bên trong thread.
LineThe retry policy is on line 126.Vị trí gắn với dòng code.
PlatformI saw your comment on Azure DevOps.Nền tảng hoạt động.
FileThe config is in appsettings.json.Nội dung file.
EnvironmentThe error happened in production.Môi trường hoạt động.
MachineThe service runs on the production VM.Host/máy chủ.
TeamsI shared the update in the Teams channel.Bên trong một channel.
Teams platformI saw your message on Teams.Nền tảng giao tiếp.
AccidentNobody was hurt in the accident.Tham gia/chịu tác động trong sự kiện.
LocationThere was an accident on the highway.Vị trí trên tuyến đường.
Cause/mannerI deleted it by accident.Vô tình (cụm by accident).
DeadlinePlease finish it by Friday.Chậm nhất là Friday (not later than).
Exact timeThe call starts at 3 PM.Mốc thời gian chính xác.
Specific dayWe reviewed it on Monday.Ngày cụ thể.
MonthThe rollout started in October.Khoảng thời gian lớn.
No later thanWe need it by 3 PM.Deadline, khác at 3 PM.
TransportI am on the bus / in the car.Cụm thông dụng cho phương tiện.
MeetingI am in a meeting / on a call.Collocations, học nguyên cụm.
LocationI am at the office / in the office.At = vị trí làm việc; in = bên trong văn phòng.
StatusThe deploy is in progress; we are working on a fix.Trạng thái vs hoạt động.
Log & dashboardThe error is in the logs; the trend is on the dashboard.Bên trong dữ liệu vs trên giao diện.
Ghi nhớ: Mental model là hướng dẫn, không thay thế việc học cụm cố định. On time = đúng giờ đã hẹn; in time = kịp trước khi quá muộn. By Friday = chậm nhất thứ Sáu; on Friday = vào thứ Sáu.

04 / Adverbs & nuance — nói chính xác, tự nhiên

Từ ảnh 50 expressions: so sánh apparently / obviously, certainly / absolutely / definitely / exactly và chọn theo mục đích.

Choose the intent first, then the word

Đừng chọn trạng từ bằng dịch nghĩa “chắc chắn / rõ ràng”. Hãy xác định bạn đang đồng ý, nhận lời, phỏng đoán, sửa thông tin, khẳng định bằng chứng hay chuyển chủ đề.

AgreementSure · Certainly · Absolutely · Exactly
ConfidenceDefinitely · Probably · Maybe · Perhaps
EvidenceApparently · Clearly · It looks like...
CorrectionActually · To clarify...
FrequencyUsually · Sometimes · Rarely · Hardly ever
Time / progressRecently · Gradually · Eventually

8 distinctions bạn sẽ gặp trong meeting

Apparently vs Obviously
Phrase A

Apparently, the agent failed after the update.

Có thông tin/dấu hiệu cho thấy; cần kiểm tra.
Phrase B

Obviously, the agent failed because of the update.

Ngụ ý nguyên nhân hiển nhiên, dễ khẳng định quá mức.
Cách nói an toàn / ngắn: It looks like the agent started failing after the update. We still need to check why.
Certainly vs Absolutely
Phrase A

Certainly, I can share the document.

Nhận lời lịch sự / thể hiện sẵn sàng.
Phrase B

Absolutely, I agree with the plan.

Đồng ý rất mạnh / nhiệt tình.
Cách nói an toàn / ngắn: Sure, I can share it. / Yes, I agree.
Definitely vs Probably
Phrase A

We’ll definitely have the demo on Friday.

Bạn chắc chắn theo lịch đã xác nhận.
Phrase B

We’ll probably have the demo on Friday.

Khả năng cao nhưng chưa chắc.
Cách nói an toàn / ngắn: The demo is planned for Friday, but it isn’t confirmed yet.
Actually vs Exactly
Phrase A

Actually, the config was updated yesterday.

Sửa lại thông tin trước đó.
Phrase B

Exactly, that’s what I meant.

Xác nhận người kia hiểu chính xác.
Cách nói an toàn / ngắn: Yes, that’s right.
Clearly vs Obviously
Phrase A

The logs clearly show a timeout.

Dựa trên evidence.
Phrase B

It’s obviously your code.

Đổ lỗi, không phù hợp khi chưa xác minh.
Cách nói an toàn / ngắn: The logs show a timeout. Let’s check where it starts.
Eventually vs Finally
Phrase A

Eventually, the VM recovered.

Sau một khoảng thời gian, cuối cùng có kết quả.
Phrase B

Finally, the VM recovered.

Nhấn sự kết thúc / cảm giác chờ đợi đã xong.
Cách nói an toàn / ngắn: The VM recovered after the restart.
Almost vs Hardly vs Barely
Phrase A

The task is almost finished.

Gần hoàn thành.
Phrase B

I can hardly hear you / I can barely hear you.

Gần như không nghe được.
Cách nói an toàn / ngắn: Could you speak a bit louder? The audio is low.
Usually vs Normally vs Typically
Phrase A

We usually deploy on Tuesdays.

Thói quen thực tế.
Phrase B

Normally, the pipeline takes ten minutes.

Quy trình / trạng thái thường lệ.
Cách nói an toàn / ngắn: Typically, this type of app uses a health check.

50 từ/cụm trong ảnh — đã thêm ví dụ thực tế và sắc thái

Các mục kind of và sort of là cụm; likely có thể là tính từ. Không phải mọi từ trong danh sách đều thay thế nhau được.

50 expressions
01 · ActuallyCorrection / contrast

thực ra

Actually, the PR gate is optional.

Say it simpler: I mean, the gate is optional.

Dùng khi sửa thông tin; đừng mở mọi câu bằng actually.

02 · BasicallySummary

về cơ bản

Basically, we need one more approval.

Say it simpler: We need one more approval.

Tóm tắt, không đủ cho các trường hợp cần chi tiết.

03 · LiterallyEmphasis

theo nghĩa đen, thực sự

The server literally stopped responding.

Say it simpler: The server stopped responding.

Dùng cho nghĩa thực, tránh phóng đại trong incident.

04 · HonestlyOpinion

thành thật mà nói

Honestly, I haven’t checked that yet.

Say it simpler: I haven’t checked that yet.

Thêm thái độ chân thành, không cần luôn có.

05 · SeriouslyReaction

nghiêm túc đấy / thật à

Seriously? That café closes at 4 PM?

Say it simpler: Really? It closes at 4 PM?

Hợp hội thoại thân quen hơn meeting trang trọng.

06 · DefinitelyStrong yes

chắc chắn (cam kết mạnh)

Yes, definitely. I can join.

Say it simpler: Yes, I can join.

Chỉ dùng khi bạn chắc chắn.

07 · ProbablyUncertainty

có lẽ, khả năng cao

It’s probably a configuration issue.

Say it simpler: I think it may be a config issue.

Không phải đã xác nhận root cause.

08 · ObviouslyStrong inference

rõ ràng (dễ gây cảm giác coi thường)

Obviously, we need approval before prod deploy.

Say it simpler: We need approval before prod deploy.

Tránh khi nói với đồng nghiệp về lỗi; có thể như trách họ.

09 · ApparentlyReported/inferred

có vẻ như, theo thông tin biết được

Apparently, the build failed overnight.

Say it simpler: It looks like the build failed overnight.

Chưa khẳng định; có thể từ người khác hoặc dấu hiệu.

10 · CertainlyPolite agreement

chắc chắn / rất sẵn lòng

Certainly, I can send you the notes.

Say it simpler: Sure, I can send the notes.

Tự nhiên khi nhận lời, lịch sự hơn sure.

11 · ClearlyEvidence

rõ ràng

The logs clearly show a DNS error.

Say it simpler: The logs show a DNS error.

Dùng khi có bằng chứng thực sự.

12 · AbsolutelyEnthusiastic agreement

hoàn toàn, rất đồng ý

Absolutely, that makes sense.

Say it simpler: Yes, that makes sense.

Thường đáp lại để đồng ý mạnh, không thay cho certainly mọi lúc.

13 · TotallyCasual agreement

hoàn toàn (casual)

I totally agree with that.

Say it simpler: I agree with that.

Khá thân mật; hợp với đồng nghiệp quen.

14 · CompletelyFull extent

hoàn toàn

The rollout is completely finished.

Say it simpler: The rollout is finished.

Nhấn mạnh toàn bộ, không phải câu trả lời “yes” mặc định.

15 · ReallyReaction/degree

thật sự / rất

That’s really helpful, thanks.

Say it simpler: That helps, thanks.

Rất linh hoạt nhưng dùng quá nhiều dễ lặp.

16 · TrulyStrong feeling

thực sự

I truly appreciate your support.

Say it simpler: I appreciate your support.

Trang trọng / cảm xúc hơn really.

17 · SimplySimplifying

đơn giản là

Simply put, the VM needs the right firewall rule.

Say it simpler: The VM needs the right firewall rule.

Giải thích, không làm nhẹ vấn đề phức tạp.

18 · NaturallyExpected result

dĩ nhiên / một cách tự nhiên

Naturally, more traffic means more load.

Say it simpler: As traffic grows, load increases.

Không phải mọi chuyện “naturally” đều hiển nhiên.

19 · TechnicallyTechnical precision

về mặt kỹ thuật

Technically, it’s possible, but it needs approval.

Say it simpler: It can work, but we need approval.

Rất hữu ích để tách khả năng kỹ thuật khỏi quyết định.

20 · EssentiallyCore meaning

về bản chất

Essentially, the agent needs more context.

Say it simpler: The agent needs more context.

Tóm ý chính, tương tự basically nhưng hơi trang trọng hơn.

21 · GenerallyGeneral pattern

nhìn chung

Generally, we review these changes weekly.

Say it simpler: We usually review these changes weekly.

Không tuyệt đối.

22 · TypicallyTypical case

thường theo mô hình chung

Typically, the pipeline runs on each PR.

Say it simpler: The pipeline usually runs on each PR.

Dùng mô tả hành vi chuẩn.

23 · UsuallyFrequency

thường

We usually have lunch around noon.

Say it simpler: Most days, we have lunch at noon.

Thói quen; không phải lúc nào cũng vậy.

24 · NormallyExpected routine

bình thường / theo lệ

Normally, the job finishes in ten minutes.

Say it simpler: It usually finishes in ten minutes.

Nhấn “theo trạng thái bình thường”.

25 · EventuallyOutcome over time

cuối cùng (sau một thời gian)

Eventually, the service recovered.

Say it simpler: The service recovered later.

KHÔNG có nghĩa eventually = perhaps/maybe.

26 · GraduallyChange over time

dần dần

We’re gradually rolling it out to more teams.

Say it simpler: We’re adding teams step by step.

Nhấn tiến triển từ từ.

27 · ConstantlyFrequency

liên tục

The service is constantly restarting.

Say it simpler: The service keeps restarting.

Có thể mang sắc thái than phiền.

28 · FrequentlyFrequency

thường xuyên

This alert fires frequently in test.

Say it simpler: This alert fires a lot in test.

Không đồng nghĩa constantly.

29 · OccasionallyFrequency

thỉnh thoảng

I occasionally work from home.

Say it simpler: Sometimes I work from home.

Trang trọng hơn sometimes một chút.

30 · RarelyLow frequency

hiếm khi

We rarely see this issue in production.

Say it simpler: We almost never see this issue.

Rarely có nghĩa ít, không phải không bao giờ.

31 · HardlyAlmost not

hầu như không

I can hardly hear you.

Say it simpler: I can barely hear you.

Phổ biến trong nói chuyện audio; tránh double negative.

32 · BarelyAlmost not

vừa đủ / gần như không

I barely had time for lunch.

Say it simpler: I almost had no time for lunch.

Cũng có nghĩa vừa đủ.

33 · SlightlySmall change

hơi, một chút

The error rate is slightly higher today.

Say it simpler: The error rate is a bit higher.

Không phóng đại mức độ.

34 · VirtuallyAlmost all

hầu như

The old endpoint is virtually unused now.

Say it simpler: Almost nobody uses the old endpoint.

Đừng dùng nếu chưa có số liệu đáng tin.

35 · PracticallyAlmost / practical

gần như / trên thực tế

The test environment is practically ready.

Say it simpler: It’s almost ready.

Không đồng nghĩa always with technically.

36 · LikelyProbability

có khả năng

The fix will likely need a redeploy.

Say it simpler: We’ll probably need to redeploy.

Likely còn là tính từ: It’s likely that...

37 · MostlyLarge portion

phần lớn

The questions were mostly about setup.

Say it simpler: Most questions were about setup.

Không có nghĩa toàn bộ.

38 · Kind ofSoftening (phrase)

hơi, kiểu như

It’s kind of tricky to reproduce.

Say it simpler: It’s a bit hard to reproduce.

Cụm nói thân mật, không phải trạng từ đơn.

39 · Sort ofSoftening (phrase)

hơi, kiểu như

I sort of agree, but I have one concern.

Say it simpler: I partly agree, but...

Khá informal; có thể thiếu dứt khoát.

40 · MaybePossibility

có lẽ

Maybe we can try this first.

Say it simpler: We could try this first.

Thân mật, không cam kết.

41 · PerhapsPossibility

có lẽ

Perhaps we can review this tomorrow.

Say it simpler: Maybe we can review it tomorrow.

Nhẹ và hơi trang trọng hơn maybe.

42 · IndeedConfirmation

đúng vậy / thực sự

Indeed, this is a useful improvement.

Say it simpler: Yes, this is useful.

Nghe formal; ít cần khi chat hằng ngày.

43 · FranklyBlunt opinion

nói thẳng là

Frankly, I don’t think we’re ready.

Say it simpler: I don’t think we’re ready yet.

Dùng thận trọng với leaders: có thể nghe gay gắt.

44 · PersonallyPersonal view

cá nhân tôi

Personally, I prefer a shorter daily meeting.

Say it simpler: I prefer a shorter daily meeting.

Cách đưa ý kiến không áp đặt.

45 · FortunatelyPositive result

may là

Fortunately, production wasn’t affected.

Say it simpler: The good news is production wasn’t affected.

Đừng dùng nếu kết quả chưa xác minh.

46 · UnfortunatelyBad news

không may

Unfortunately, the deployment failed.

Say it simpler: The deployment failed.

Làm mềm thông báo tin xấu.

47 · SurprisinglyUnexpected

đáng ngạc nhiên

Surprisingly, the second run passed.

Say it simpler: The second run passed, which was unexpected.

Cho thấy trái dự đoán.

48 · InterestinglyNoteworthy

điều thú vị là

Interestingly, both teams reported the same issue.

Say it simpler: Both teams reported the same issue.

Dùng để giới thiệu insight.

49 · ThankfullyRelief/gratitude

may thay

Thankfully, nobody was affected.

Say it simpler: Luckily, nobody was affected.

Không xác nhận an toàn khi còn thiếu evidence.

50 · AnywayTransition

dù sao / quay lại chủ đề

Anyway, let’s get back to the deployment.

Say it simpler: Let’s get back to the deployment.

Có thể nghe cắt lời nếu dùng quá đột ngột.

⚠ “Obviously” thường mang ý người nghe lẽ ra phải biết, nên dễ thiếu tế nhị. “Apparently” có thể mang sắc thái mỉa mai nếu nói không đúng ngữ điệu. Khi chưa chắc, dùng “It looks like...” hoặc “From what I can see...” sẽ an toàn hơn.

05 / Present Perfect Simple — chuyện đời sống & status công việc

Phân biệt I've done, I did, I've been doing; học lately, recently, these days, for, since và ever since.

HAVE / HAS + V3

Present Perfect Simple

Quá khứ nối với hiện tại: kết quả hiện tại · trải nghiệm · một khoảng thời gian vẫn tiếp diễn.

V2 / -ed

Past Simple

Việc hoàn tất ở một mốc quá khứ: yesterday, last Friday, in 2025, at 18:15.

HAVE BEEN + -ING

Present Perfect Continuous

Nhấn quá trình, thời lượng: I've been checking the logs all morning.

14 patterns dùng tại lunch và meeting

Mục đíchCâu ví dụNghĩa / khi dùngMẫu có thể thay
Trải nghiệm chưa nói thời điểmHave you tried egg coffee?Bạn đã từng thử cà phê trứng chưa?Have you tried ... yet?
Kết quả liên quan hiện tạiI’ve updated the configuration.Tôi đã update và kết quả vẫn liên quan hiện tại.I’ve updated...
Tin mớiWe’ve just received feedback from EDI.Chúng tôi vừa nhận feedback.We’ve just received...
Còn chưa xongI haven’t checked that yet.Đến hiện tại vẫn chưa kiểm tra.I haven’t ... yet.
Trải nghiệm trong đời sốngI’ve never been to Da Lat.Tôi chưa từng đến Đà Lạt.I’ve never...
Khoảng thời gian tiếp tục đến nayI’ve lived in Vietnam for five years.Tôi sống ở Việt Nam được 5 năm (vẫn sống).I’ve ... for ...
Bắt đầu từ mốc quá khứI’ve known him since 2021.Tôi biết anh ấy từ 2021 đến nay.I’ve ... since ...
LatelyLately, I’ve been quite busy.Dạo gần đây tôi khá bận.Lately, I’ve...
RecentlyI’ve recently started learning French.Tôi mới bắt đầu học tiếng Pháp gần đây.I’ve recently...
These daysThese days, I work from home more often.Dạo này tôi thường làm tại nhà hơn.These days, I... (present simple)
For the past few daysI’ve felt tired for the past few days.Tôi mệt trong vài ngày qua.I’ve felt... for...
Continuous focusI’ve been working on it all morning.Tôi đã và đang làm suốt buổi sáng.I’ve been working on...
Past finished timeWe fixed it yesterday.Chúng tôi đã sửa hôm qua.NOT: We have fixed it yesterday.
Exact meeting pastI spoke to Joel on Monday.Tôi đã nói chuyện với Joel thứ Hai.Past simple when time is specified.

When to use the image phrases

  • Lately: dạo gần đây; hay đi với Present Perfect / Continuous. Lately, I've been sleeping better.
  • These days: thời gian gần đây, hiện tại; thường dùng present simple/continuous. These days, I spend more time at home.
  • Recently: vừa mới / gần đây, dùng được với Present Perfect hoặc Past Simple tuỳ ngữ cảnh. I recently started learning French.
  • For the past few days: trong vài ngày qua; thường dùng Present Perfect / Continuous. I've been feeling tired for the past few days.
  • Ever since: kể từ khi có sự kiện. Ever since I moved here, I've felt more at home.

Fast grammar decisions

Có mốc hoàn tất? yesterday / last Monday / in 2024→ PAST SIMPLE
Trải nghiệm hay kết quả hiện tại? ever / never / already / yet / just→ PRESENT PERFECT
Nhấn hoạt động đang kéo dài? all morning / for hours→ PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS
Đừng nói “I've updated the config yesterday.”
Nói “I updated the config yesterday.” hoặc “I've updated the config.”

Two useful dialogues: everyday life / incident

☕ At a café

GM: Have you tried this place before?

You: Yes, I've been here a few times. Their coffee is really good.

GM: Nice. Has it always been this busy?

You: Not really. It's become more popular recently.

💻 During a review

Manager: Have you checked the PR comments?

You: Yes, I've reviewed them. One comment is still unresolved.

Manager: Did you check it yesterday?

You: Yes, I checked it yesterday, but the author hasn't replied yet.

06 / When you miss something — xin nhắc lại gọn, lịch sự

Không cần câu phức tạp để xử lý accent, mạng chập chờn, micro nhỏ hoặc một ý chưa rõ.

Simple is good: “Can you say it again?” và “Can you say it one more time?” đều đúng. “Can you explain it another way?” cũng đúng tiếng Anh, nhưng không phù hợp nếu vấn đề chỉ là bạn không nghe rõ.

10 ways to keep the meeting moving

Mục đíchCâu nên nóiLưu ý
Không nghe rõ / audio rèSorry, I didn’t catch that. Could you say it again? Bạn cần người kia nói lại, không cần giải thích cách khác.
Cần lặp lại lần nữaCould you say that one more time? Trung tính, ngắn gọn.
Họ nói nhanhCould you speak a bit slower? Câu tự nhiên để xin giảm tốc độ nói.
Âm thanh nhỏCould you speak a bit louder? I can barely hear you. Phù hợp nếu âm lượng thấp; “I can’t hear you well” cũng đúng.
Mất tiếng cuối câuSorry, you cut out for a second. What was the last part? Vấn đề kết nối, không đổ lỗi accent.
Không hiểu ýCould you explain that a bit more? Bạn nghe được nhưng chưa hiểu. Chỉ dùng lúc cần giải thích.
Cần ví dụCould you give me a quick example? Bạn hiểu lý thuyết nhưng cần ví dụ.
Xác nhận lạiSo you mean the PR gate is optional, right? Diễn đạt lại để confirm.
Nghe kém vì micI think your mic is a bit low. Nhẹ nhàng, tập trung vào thiết bị.
Cần chia sẻ màn hìnhCould you share your screen for a second? Đúng khi cần nhìn ví dụ/config.

1 · Can't hear

“Could you say that again?”

Nghe chưa rõ → nhắc lại.

2 · Too fast

“Could you speak a bit slower?”

Nghe không kịp → chậm lại.

3 · Don't understand

“Could you give me an example?”

Đã nghe rõ nhưng chưa hiểu → ví dụ / diễn giải.

07 / Lunch, café & after-work với PMO + General Manager

Giao tiếp thân thiện, tự nhiên và có chia sẻ hai chiều. Có thể nói nhẹ về việc làm nhưng tránh biến bữa ăn thành cuộc họp hay cuộc phỏng vấn.

Conversation ladder — đi từ dễ đến gần gũi

1 · Observe

Mưa, đường, quán ăn, cà phê

2 · Share

Kể ngắn trải nghiệm của mình

3 · Ask

Một câu mở, không dồn dập

4 · Follow

Theo ý họ hoặc đổi chủ đề

Mental model: 1 question → 1 personal share → 1 natural follow-up. Không cần lên lịch trước tất cả câu hỏi.

Nhịp một bữa trưa 30 phút — minh họa, không phải quy định

0–5’ · Warm upQuán ăn / đồ uống
5–15’ · Everyday lifeThời tiết / café / cuối tuần / trải nghiệm sống
15–20’ · Light workNếu người khác chủ động nhắc tới
20–30’ · Relaxed closeTrở về chủ đề đời sống / kết thúc tự nhiên

Không đặt mục tiêu khai thác thông tin. Quan tâm thật đến câu trả lời của họ, và chủ động chia sẻ trải nghiệm của bạn.

Chủ đề an toàn, dễ nói

  • Thời tiết, mưa ngập, di chuyển và đường phố
  • Ẩm thực, món ăn Việt–Pháp, cà phê, quán mới
  • Cuối tuần, du lịch, thể thao, sở thích
  • Cuộc sống ở Việt Nam qua trải nghiệm cá nhân
  • Học tiếng Pháp/tiếng Anh, công nghệ dùng hằng ngày
  • Chia sẻ công việc ngắn: đang học gì, dự án tiến triển ra sao

Giữ ranh giới tinh tế

  • Tránh hỏi dồn về lương, gia đình, nhà cửa, tài chính.
  • Tránh gợi chuyện đánh giá đồng nghiệp hoặc chuyện nội bộ chưa công khai.
  • Với GM, không tranh thủ bữa trưa để xin phê duyệt hoặc hỏi ngân sách nhạy cảm.
  • Không áp đặt quan điểm về người Pháp/Việt, chính trị, rượu bia.
  • Nếu người khác ít nói, tôn trọng khoảng lặng.

12 câu mở chủ đề có thể dùng hằng tuần

Restaurant

Have you tried this place before?

Quán này bạn thử chưa?
Coffee

Do you usually go for espresso or Vietnamese coffee?

Bạn hay chọn espresso hay cà phê Việt?
Rain

Did the rain affect your journey home yesterday?

Mưa hôm qua có làm bạn về nhà khó hơn không?
Weekend

Any plans for the weekend?

Cuối tuần có kế hoạch gì không?
Living here

What do you enjoy most about living here?

Bạn thích điều gì nhất ở đây?
Travel

Have you been anywhere interesting recently?

Gần đây bạn có đi đâu thú vị không?
Football

Do you follow football at all?

Bạn có xem bóng đá không?
Food

What kind of food do you feel like today?

Hôm nay bạn muốn ăn món gì?
Music

Have you been listening to anything good lately?

Gần đây có nghe gì hay không?
Learning

I've started learning a little French.

Mình bắt đầu học một ít tiếng Pháp.
Work, light

Things are going well so far. We're getting useful feedback.

Cập nhật 1 câu nếu ai đó hỏi công việc.
Closing

Thanks, that was a nice lunch.

Cảm ơn, bữa trưa rất vui.

08 / Role-play library — hội thoại đọc thành tiếng

171 hội thoại, gồm 24 tình huống mới trong meeting. Chọn Social / Work / Course, đọc lời “You”, dùng Hide my lines để tự luyện phản xạ.

S01 · Gặp nhau trước khi đi ănChọn quán ăn, mở câu chuyện⌄
YouAre we going to the usual place today, or do you want to try somewhere new?
PMOI’m happy to try something new.
YouThere’s a small Vietnamese restaurant nearby. Their lunch set is quite good.
GMSounds good. Let’s give it a try.
YouGreat. It’s about a five-minute walk.
Chunks: usual place, try somewhere new, give it a try
Hỏi sở thích nhẹ nhàng, không cần tổ chức cả buổi ăn như một cuộc họp.
S02 · Người Pháp sống tại Việt NamTrò chuyện tự nhiên về trải nghiệm sống⌄
YouYou’ve been living in Vietnam for quite a while now, right?
GMYes, about five years.
YouWhat do you enjoy most about living here?
GMThe food and the energy of the city.
YouI can see that. The food is probably what I’d miss most if I moved away.
Chunks: quite a while, what do you enjoy most, I can see that
Một câu hỏi mở + một chia sẻ về bản thân. Không hỏi dồn dập nhiều chi tiết đời tư.
S03 · Mưa và ngập ở Sài GònSmall talk về thời tiết, giao thông⌄
YouThe rain was really heavy yesterday evening.
PMOYes, the traffic was terrible.
YouMy journey home took almost an hour longer than usual.
GMSome streets were flooded near my place.
YouReally? I hope getting home wasn’t too difficult.
Chunks: heavy rain, traffic was terrible, longer than usual
Tránh câu áp đặt như “Vietnam traffic is always a mess”; kể chuyện riêng nhẹ hơn.
S04 · Cà phê Việt và PhápChuyện café nhẹ, dễ mở rộng⌄
YouDo you usually go for Vietnamese coffee or espresso?
GMUsually espresso, but I like Vietnamese coffee too.
YouI often have iced milk coffee in the afternoon. It’s quite strong, though.
GMYes, I noticed!
YouMaybe next time we can try a place with both options.
Chunks: go for, iced milk coffee, quite strong
Không khẳng định gu của mọi người Pháp; hỏi đúng sở thích từng người.
S05 · Cà phê chồnGiải thích một nét văn hóa không làm quá⌄
GMI heard about weasel coffee. Have you tried it?
YouYes, I’ve heard of it. It’s known as a specialty coffee, but I don’t drink it often.
PMOIs it expensive?
YouIt can be. I usually prefer a regular Vietnamese coffee.
GMFair enough!
Chunks: have you tried, specialty coffee, fair enough
Không cần giới thiệu là “best coffee”; có thể nói thêm về đạo đức sản xuất nếu người khác quan tâm.
S06 · Nói về đồ ăn trưaĐồ ăn, món mới, khẩu vị⌄
YouHave you tried bún bò before?
GMYes, but not at this place.
YouThis version is a bit spicy. You can ask for less chili.
GMThat sounds good.
YouLet me know what you think.
Chunks: have you tried, a bit spicy, what do you think
Câu ngắn, dễ phát âm; đừng ép người khác phải thử món lạ.
S07 · Cuối tuần đi đâuKế hoạch cuối tuần, không xâm phạm riêng tư⌄
YouAny plans for the weekend?
PMONothing special. Maybe a short trip.
YouNice. I’m thinking of staying in the city and finding a new café.
GMSometimes a quiet weekend is the best.
YouExactly. It helps me recharge.
Chunks: any plans for, nothing special, recharge
Nếu câu trả lời ngắn, chuyển qua chủ đề khác; không hỏi “với ai, ở đâu, mấy giờ” liên tục.
S08 · Cuộc sống ở Việt Nam so với PhápSo sánh văn hóa một cách cởi mở⌄
YouIs there anything you miss from France?
GMSometimes the bread and the slower weekends.
YouThat makes sense. I really like how easy it is to get food here in the evening.
GMYes, that’s one thing I enjoy here.
YouEvery place has its good sides.
Chunks: miss from, that makes sense, good sides
Không khái quát kiểu “French people always…”; nói về trải nghiệm cá nhân.
S09 · Khi nói về công việc lúc ăn trưaCập nhật ngắn, không biến bữa ăn thành status meeting⌄
GMHow is the coding-agent rollout going?
YouWe’re getting useful feedback from the teams.
GMAnything worrying?
YouNothing major confirmed so far. We’re checking a few issues with the setup team.
YouAnyway, we can go through the details at work. Have you tried this dish?
Chunks: rollout, nothing major confirmed, go through the details
Đợi chủ đề xuất hiện tự nhiên; trả lời 1–2 câu, không khai thác thông tin chiến lược hoặc chuyện nội bộ.
S10 · Chủ động nói một chút về role TAChia sẻ đủ thông tin, tránh báo cáo dài⌄
PMOHow’s the new TA role going?
YouGood so far. I’m getting more feedback from the teams and helping them with technical issues.
GMThat sounds busy.
YouA bit, yes. But I’m learning a lot, which is nice.
PMOThat’s good to hear.
Chunks: good so far, a bit, learning a lot
Chia sẻ trải nghiệm thật của mình; tránh biến small talk thành yêu cầu phê duyệt công việc.
S11 · Chuyện bóng đá / thể thaoHỏi sở thích mà không mặc định⌄
YouDo you follow football at all?
GMA little, mostly big matches.
YouSame here. I usually watch the big tournaments, not every match.
GMThat’s enough to keep up.
YouExactly!
Chunks: at all, mostly, keep up
Đừng mặc định người Pháp nào cũng thích bóng đá.
S12 · Đi nhậu / uống nước sau giờ làmMời tự nhiên, không gây áp lực uống rượu⌄
YouA few of us are going out after work on Friday. Would you like to join?
PMOMaybe. Is it dinner or just drinks?
YouA bit of both. No pressure, and there are non-alcoholic options too.
GMI might stop by for a while.
YouSounds good. Join us if you’re free.
Chunks: go out after work, no pressure, stop by
Tôn trọng lựa chọn không uống cồn và giới hạn thời gian của người khác.
S13 · Khi gọi món và thanh toánNói lịch sự mà không trang trọng quá⌄
YouShall we order a few dishes to share?
GMYes, that works.
PMOCould we get one more plate of vegetables?
YouSure. And should we ask for the bill?
GMYes, let’s do that.
Chunks: dishes to share, that works, ask for the bill
Shall we...? là lời gợi ý mềm. “Could we get...?” rất phổ biến trong quán ăn.
S14 · Giám đốc đang ít nóiKhông ép người khác tiếp chuyện⌄
YouThe place is a bit busy today.
GMYes, it is.
YouThe food looks good, though.
GMIt does.
YouEnjoy your lunch!
Chunks: a bit busy, looks good, enjoy your lunch
Nếu người khác ít nói, để khoảng lặng tự nhiên là hoàn toàn ổn.
S15 · Chuyển sang tiếng Anh khi bàn kỹ thuậtChuyển ngôn ngữ lịch sự⌄
PMO[Explains a technical point in French.]
YouSorry, could we switch to English for this part? I want to make sure I follow the technical details.
PMOOf course. We were talking about the deployment timeline.
YouGot it, thanks. So the main concern is the release date, right?
Chunks: switch to English, make sure I follow, main concern
Không yêu cầu cả bàn chuyển ngôn ngữ chỉ vì đoạn small talk; xin chuyển ở phần cần tham gia.
S16 · Kết thúc buổi ănChuyển về công việc tự nhiên⌄
YouThanks, that was a nice lunch.
GMYes, good choice.
YouGlad you liked it. I’ll get back to the agent feedback this afternoon.
PMOSee you in the meeting.
YouSee you later!
Chunks: nice lunch, glad you liked it, see you later
Nói ngắn và tự nhiên. “I’m grateful for all your support” quá nặng cho tình huống này.
S17 · Nói về học tiếng PhápChia sẻ mục tiêu mới, mở cơ hội luyện nói⌄
YouI’ve started learning a little French.
GMOh, nice! How is it going?
YouSlowly, but I’m trying to practice a bit every day.
PMOHave you learned any useful phrases?
YouJust a few basic ones. I’m still at the beginning.
Chunks: how is it going, a little, still at the beginning
Nếu họ muốn dạy vài từ, tiếp tục; nếu không, không tạo áp lực.
S18 · Khi bị hỏi chuyện cá nhânTrả lời vừa đủ và đổi chủ đề⌄
GMAny big plans for your holiday?
YouNothing big. I’ll probably spend some time with family and get some rest.
GMSounds nice.
YouYes, I’m looking forward to a quiet break. How about you?
Chunks: nothing big, get some rest, looking forward to
Trả lời theo mức thoải mái, không cần tiết lộ thông tin cá nhân.
W01 · Daily update coding agentFeedback, root cause, next step⌄
YouQuick update from my side. I got feedback from the X1 and EDI teams on the pull-ticket and PR review skills.
ColleagueHave you found the root cause?
YouNot yet. I’m working with both teams to narrow it down.
ColleagueAny blockers?
YouNothing blocking for now. I’ll work with the setup team and share an update.
Chunks: quick update from my side, narrow it down, nothing blocking
Tách feedback nhận được khỏi nguyên nhân chưa xác nhận.
W02 · AI agent trả lời saiExplain hallucination without blaming people⌄
PMOWhy did the agent suggest the wrong code?
YouIt looks like the agent didn’t have enough project context.
PMOSo we need to retrain it?
YouNot necessarily. First, let’s check the instructions, context, and examples we provide.
PMOMakes sense. How will we test the change?
YouWe’ll rerun the same cases and compare the results.
Chunks: it looks like, not necessarily, rerun the same cases
“Hallucination” có nghĩa output AI tạo ra không đáng tin, nhưng không phải mọi bug đều là hallucination.
W03 · Quality of coding-agent skillsAssess improvement without overclaiming⌄
YouWe’ve made a small improvement in the PR review skill.
ColleagueIs it ready for everyone?
YouNot yet. It looks better on our test cases, but we need more feedback from real projects.
ColleagueWhat’s the next step?
YouWe’ll test it with one more team before wider rollout.
Chunks: test cases, real projects, wider rollout
Luôn phân biệt “tested” và “fully rolled out”.
W04 · Agent version config changeHighlight changes that matter⌄
ColleagueWill version 1.0.25 require any setup changes?
YouIf any configuration changes are needed, I’ll highlight them clearly in the channel.
ColleagueCan you make the steps more precise?
YouYes. I’ll include the exact settings and an example.
Chunks: configuration changes, highlight, more precise
Không xác nhận cần thay đổi config nếu chưa biết thực tế.
W05 · Daily 60 minutes quá dàiDisagree gently with manager⌄
YouCan I raise one point about this meeting?
ManagerSure, go ahead.
YouDo you think one hour is a bit too long since we meet every day? I think 30 minutes should be enough, no?
ManagerWhat about longer topics?
YouWe can cover those separately when needed.
Chunks: raise one point, a bit too long, cover separately
“No?” có thể dùng trong nhóm quen; “right?” đôi khi rõ hơn với người mới.
W06 · SonarQube coverageCoverage ≠ quality gate / branch policy⌄
PMOWhy is the code coverage check shown as optional?
YouThe pipeline publishes the coverage result, but the branch policy may not require that specific status.
PMOSo the Quality Gate isn’t enough?
YouThey’re different controls. We need to check which status is required for this branch.
PMOWhat should we do?
YouLet’s review the branch policy and the pipeline checks together.
Chunks: shown as optional, different controls, branch policy
Chỉ nói “may not” khi chưa kiểm tra policy của branch thực tế.
W07 · Snyk vulnerability reviewSeparate severity, exposure, fix priority⌄
PMOSnyk found a high-severity vulnerability. Is production at risk?
YouIt needs investigation. Severity alone doesn’t tell us whether the vulnerable code is reachable.
PMOWhat do we check first?
YouThe affected package and version, how it’s used, and whether a fix is available.
PMOWho should own it?
YouLet’s assign the project Tech Lead and agree on a target date.
Chunks: high severity, reachable code, fix available
Không nói high severity = chắc chắn có thể khai thác trên PROD.
W08 · Snyk và private NuGet feedDifference between CI auth and platform import⌄
DeveloperThe pipeline can restore the private NuGet package, but Snyk doesn’t show the dependency.
YouLet’s separate the two cases. CI restore access doesn’t automatically prove the Snyk integration can resolve it.
DeveloperHow should we test it?
YouWe can try a small test project and compare the scan results.
DeveloperShould we reimport the repository?
YouFirst, let’s check the integration settings and the latest scan details.
Chunks: doesn’t automatically prove, test project, scan results
Mô tả quy trình xác minh, không kết luận trước nguyên nhân.
W09 · SonarQube × Snyk reconciliationDecide what to exclude and onboard⌄
YouWe’ve compared the SonarQube and Snyk project lists.
PMOWhat are the gaps?
YouSome projects should be excluded, and some still need to be onboarded to Snyk.
PMOWho follows up?
YouLet’s confirm the owners and priorities. The Tech Leads can handle the project updates, with my support.
Chunks: compared the lists, onboarded, with my support
Mỗi action cần owner, priority, next step.
W10 · Incident report connection stringConfirmed vs likely vs unknown⌄
ManagerDid the retry policy change the SQL connection string?
YouNo. It retried the configured endpoint and made the failed requests last longer.
ManagerThen why did the old endpoint appear after deployment?
YouThat part is still unconfirmed. We’re checking the effective runtime configuration and DNS results.
ManagerWas production affected?
YouWe need to rely on the environment-specific logs before making that conclusion.
Chunks: configured endpoint, still unconfirmed, environment-specific logs
Không chuyển suy đoán thành nguyên nhân chắc chắn.
W11 · Deployment issue / rollbackExplain rollback and validate⌄
PMOThe new release failed. What did you do?
YouWe rolled back to the previous build, and the endpoint started responding again.
PMOIs the issue fully resolved?
YouIt looks stable in the logs we checked, but we still need to validate it under normal traffic.
Chunks: rolled back, previous build, normal traffic
“No more errors observed” không đồng nghĩa “fully resolved”.
W12 · Request access to Key VaultClarify minimum access and development flow⌄
ManagerDo developers need access to the production Key Vault to develop?
YouNot necessarily. We should separate local development from production access.
ManagerWhat do they need?
YouUsually access to approved non-production settings or a safe local configuration. Production access should follow the access policy.
ManagerCan you document the options?
YouYes, I’ll put together a short comparison.
Chunks: not necessarily, separate local from production, access policy
Đừng mặc định developer phải có quyền đọc PROD secrets.
W13 · Developer Git PR policyExplain blocking vs optional⌄
DeveloperThe check passed, but I can still merge without it.
YouThen it may not be configured as a required policy for this target branch.
DeveloperShould we make it required?
YouLet’s confirm the expected governance and review any exceptions first.
Chunks: required policy, target branch, review exceptions
Required branch checks phải kiểm chứng ở đúng branch và đúng status context.
W14 · Meeting có người nói quá nhanhAsk for repeat, confirm decision⌄
YouSorry, I missed the last part. Could you say that a bit more slowly?
ColleagueWe need a configuration change before the release.
YouGot it. Just to make sure I understood, it’s required before deployment, right?
ColleagueExactly.
YouOkay, I’ll post that in the channel.
Chunks: missed the last part, a bit more slowly, just to make sure
Hỏi lại để hiểu đúng không phải thiếu chuyên môn.
W15 · Team chưa có blockerOffice hours skip session⌄
YouHi everyone, any questions or blockers for today’s Tech Office Hours?
DeveloperNothing from my side.
YouOkay. If no topics come up, we’ll skip the 3 PM session.
YouNo topics were raised today, so we’ll skip the session. Please post here if you need help.
Chunks: any blockers, if no topics come up, skip the session
Skip/cancel khi chưa bắt đầu; wrap up khi họp đã diễn ra.
W16 · Trình bày technical risk cho managerImpact before low-level details⌄
ManagerIs this still a network connectivity issue?
YouNot anymore. The service is reachable. The remaining concern is security.
ManagerWhat’s the risk?
YouThe current firewall rule may allow more traffic than we need.
ManagerWhat do you recommend?
YouLet’s limit it to the required source, destination, and port, then test again.
Chunks: not anymore, remaining concern, limit access
Đối với non-technical GM: vấn đề → impact → giải pháp, tránh technical deep dive.
W17 · PR documentation / wikiSuggest improvement, not impose⌄
YouOne quick point about the PR process.
DeveloperSure.
YouIf a PR changes the docs directory, I think we should update the relevant wiki page as well.
DeveloperEven for minor edits?
YouLet’s define which changes need a wiki update, so both sources stay in sync.
Chunks: one quick point, as well, stay in sync
Nếu không có policy bắt buộc, dùng “I think we should” thay vì tuyên bố must.
C01 · Instructor: imminent shutdownAnticipate then sequence the events⌄
InstructorThe shutdown is imminent, so the service should stop accepting new requests.
YouSo “imminent” means it is expected very soon, right?
InstructorExactly. Then let in-flight requests finish if the platform allows enough time.
YouThat’s a graceful shutdown rather than an abrupt stop.
Chunks: imminent, in-flight requests, graceful shutdown
Platform-specific timeout và signal handling khác nhau; tham khảo docs riêng cho Cloud Run/ACA/K8s.
C02 · Spin up / tear down a VMDecode a cloud instructor’s phrasing⌄
InstructorSpin up a test VM for the afternoon, then tear it down.
YouSo create and start it, run the test, and delete the resources afterward?
InstructorExactly. It’s a short-lived workload.
Chunks: spin up, tear down, short-lived
Không đồng nhất shut down VM với delete resource; chi phí có thể vẫn phát sinh tùy cấu hình.
C03 · Route vs firewall rulesUnderstand reachability versus security⌄
InstructorRoutes govern where packets go. Firewall rules govern what traffic is allowed.
YouSo routing steers traffic, while firewall rules allow or block it.
InstructorRight. A reachable VM isn’t automatically secure.
YouWe should check whether the firewall is too permissive.
Chunks: govern, steer traffic, too permissive
Một workload reachable chưa chắc an toàn hoặc khỏe mạnh.
C04 · Cloud scaleListen to the underlying trade-off⌄
InstructorThis design tends to scale better, but there’s a trade-off.
YouThat means it often handles more load, but we give up something else?
InstructorRight. We might gain scalability but add more operational complexity.
Chunks: tends to, trade-off, operational complexity
Tend to ≠ always. Trade-off cần nghe cả lợi và chi phí.
C05 · Retry + backoffUnderstand intended behavior⌄
InstructorIf the request fails, retry with exponential backoff.
YouSo the wait between retries increases, instead of retrying continuously?
InstructorExactly. It can reduce pressure during temporary failures.
YouBut retries won’t fix a wrong connection string.
Chunks: exponential backoff, temporary failure, retrying continuously
Retry giảm transient failures khi thiết kế đúng; không tự sửa cấu hình.
S19 · Gọi món mới với GMĂn trưa · món Việt⌄
GMHave you tried the fish here?
YouNot yet, but I’ve heard it’s good. Have you tried it?
GMYes, a couple of times. It’s a bit spicy.
YouThat sounds good. I might give it a try.
Useful chunks: not yet · a couple of times · give it a try
Tip: “Have you tried...?” tự nhiên hơn kiểm tra kiến thức của người kia.
S20 · Bạn có uống cà phê đậm không?Café · khẩu vị⌄
YouDo you usually drink your coffee strong?
ColleagueNot too strong. I normally have a latte.
YouI usually go for Vietnamese iced coffee, but it’s pretty strong.
ColleagueYes, I’ve tried it. It keeps me awake!
Useful chunks: usually · normally · I go for
Tip: Đưa trải nghiệm cá nhân để người kia dễ đáp lại.
S21 · Đã thử quán mới chưa?Gần công ty · khám phá⌄
YouHave you been to the new café near the office?
PMONot yet. Is it good?
YouI went there last weekend. The coffee is nice and it’s quiet.
PMOSounds good. We could try it next week.
Useful chunks: Have you been to · I went there · Sounds good
Tip: Đối chiếu Present Perfect với Past Simple.
S22 · Mưa ngập đường vềSài Gòn · thời tiết⌄
GMWas the traffic bad yesterday?
YouPretty bad. It rained heavily, and a few streets were flooded.
GMDid it take long to get home?
YouYes, a bit longer than usual. How was your ride?
Useful chunks: pretty bad · a bit longer than usual · How was your ride?
Tip: Không cần chuyển ngay sang chuyện hạ tầng công ty.
S23 · Cuối tuần vừa rồiMonday lunch⌄
YouHow was your weekend?
ColleagueGood, thanks. I went to the beach.
YouNice. I’ve been meaning to go there. Was it crowded?
ColleagueNot too bad, actually.
Useful chunks: I’ve been meaning to · not too bad
Tip: Dùng “actually” đúng mức khi sửa kỳ vọng.
S24 · Hỏi về cuối tuần sắp tớiFriday coffee⌄
PMOAny plans for the weekend?
YouNothing big. I’ll probably go for a run and relax at home. How about you?
PMOI might try a new restaurant.
YouSounds nice. Let me know if it’s good!
Useful chunks: Nothing big · probably · might
Tip: Không ép người kia kể chuyện riêng tư.
S25 · Sống ở Việt Nam lâu rồiLunch với GM · hỏi nhẹ⌄
YouYou’ve been in Vietnam for quite a while now, right?
GMYes, about five years.
YouThat’s great. What do you enjoy most about living here?
GMThe food, for sure. And there’s always something going on.
YouI can see that. There are so many places to try.
Useful chunks: for quite a while · enjoy most · I can see that
Tip: Đặt câu hỏi về trải nghiệm cuộc sống, không dò hỏi công việc hay lương.
S26 · Ẩm thực Pháp và ViệtLunch · sở thích⌄
GMI still miss some French food.
YouI can imagine. Is there a dish you really miss?
GMA good cheese plate, maybe.
YouThat makes sense. I’d probably miss Vietnamese food if I lived abroad.
Useful chunks: I can imagine · That makes sense · I’d probably
Tip: Chia sẻ ngược, không quy chụp “French people always...”.
S27 · Cà phê chồnCoffee conversation⌄
GMI’ve heard about weasel coffee. Have you tried it?
YouI haven’t tried it myself. It’s quite well-known here.
GMIs it very different?
YouI’m not sure. I’ve heard different opinions about it.
Useful chunks: I haven’t tried it myself · I’ve heard
Tip: Không khẳng định điều bạn chưa trải nghiệm.
S28 · Quán ăn có đông khôngAfter work · chọn địa điểm⌄
YouIs this place usually crowded on Fridays?
PMOIt can get busy after six.
YouMaybe we should get there a bit earlier.
PMOGood idea. I’ll check with the others.
Useful chunks: usually crowded · get there earlier
Tip: Maybe = gợi ý nhẹ.
S29 · Món quá cayLunch · phản ứng tự nhiên⌄
GMHow’s your food?
YouReally good, but it’s a bit spicy for me.
GMDo you want some water?
YouYes, please. Thanks. I still like it, though.
Useful chunks: a bit spicy · though · really good
Tip: Cách góp ý nhẹ, không chê thẳng món ăn.
S30 · Bữa trưa thứ SáuAfter-work drinks invite⌄
PMOA few of us are going for a drink after work. Would you like to join?
YouSure, thanks for inviting me. I can stay for a bit.
PMOGreat. We’ll meet downstairs at six.
YouPerfect, see you there.
Useful chunks: thanks for inviting me · for a bit
Tip: Câu tự nhiên khi tham gia nhưng không ở lại lâu.
S31 · Từ chối đi nhậu khéo léoSau giờ làm⌄
ColleagueAre you joining us tonight?
YouThanks for asking. I can’t make it tonight, but maybe next time.
ColleagueNo worries. See you tomorrow.
YouHave fun!
Useful chunks: can’t make it · maybe next time
Tip: Không cần giải thích quá nhiều lý do riêng.
S32 · Thói quen tập thể dụcCafé · sức khoẻ nhẹ nhàng⌄
GMYou look energetic today.
YouThanks. I’ve been running a bit more lately.
GMNice. Do you run in the morning?
YouUsually after work. It helps me clear my head.
Useful chunks: I’ve been running lately · clear my head
Tip: Luyện thì hoàn thành tiếp diễn một cách tự nhiên.
S33 · Du lịch trong Việt NamLunch · thành phố yêu thích⌄
YouHave you visited Da Lat before?
ColleagueYes, once. I liked the weather.
YouSame here. It’s much cooler than Ho Chi Minh City.
ColleagueExactly. And the cafés were nice.
Useful chunks: Have you visited · Same here · Exactly
Tip: Exactly = đồng ý về đúng ý/chi tiết.
S34 · Mua quà quêBefore a holiday⌄
ColleagueAre you going anywhere for the holiday?
YouI’m visiting my family for a few days.
ColleagueNice. Is it far from here?
YouNot too far. It’s about a three-hour drive.
Useful chunks: for a few days · not too far
Tip: Không hỏi sâu về gia đình khi người kia chưa chủ động.
S35 · Đồ ăn trưa gần văn phòngFood recommendation⌄
GMAny good lunch places around here?
YouThere’s a small noodle place just around the corner.
GMIs it usually busy?
YouYes, but the service is quite fast. We could try it sometime.
Useful chunks: around the corner · quite fast
Tip: Khơi chuyện rất đơn giản.
S36 · Chuyện mùa mưaWeather shift⌄
GMHas it been raining a lot lately?
YouYes, almost every afternoon this week.
GMI still haven’t got used to it.
YouI know. Sometimes it starts out of nowhere.
Useful chunks: Has it been raining · get used to
Tip: Có thể nói “almost every afternoon”; “has been raining a lot” nhấn diễn biến gần đây.
S37 · Không hiểu khi ngồi bàn ănGroup lunch · ồn⌄
Colleague[says something quickly]
YouSorry, I didn’t catch that. Could you say it again?
ColleagueI asked if you’ve tried this dessert.
YouAh, not yet. It looks good!
Useful chunks: I didn’t catch that · say it again
Tip: Hỏi lại đúng vấn đề nghe không rõ.
S38 · Quay từ công việc sang đời sốngLunch · chuyển chủ đề⌄
PMOThe rollout has been quite busy lately.
YouYes, but we’re making progress. Anyway, have you tried the new lunch place downstairs?
PMONot yet. Is it good?
YouI tried it yesterday. The food was nice.
Useful chunks: making progress · anyway · I tried it yesterday
Tip: Anyway có thể chuyển chủ đề, nhưng đừng ngắt lời người khác.
S39 · Sở thích cuối tuần mớiCoffee break⌄
ColleagueWhat have you been doing outside work lately?
YouI’ve started learning a bit of French. Just simple everyday phrases.
ColleagueNice! Is it going well?
YouSlowly, but it’s fun. I’m trying to practice a little every day.
Useful chunks: I’ve started · going well · a little every day
Tip: Cách chia sẻ việc học tiếng Pháp mà không tạo áp lực.
S40 · Tạm biệt sau bữa trưaEnding naturally⌄
GMThat was a good lunch.
YouYes, I enjoyed it. Thanks for the suggestion.
GMWe should come back sometime.
YouDefinitely. See you back at the office.
Useful chunks: I enjoyed it · sometime · See you back
Tip: Nói ngắn; không phải thêm câu chuyện công việc để giữ cuộc trò chuyện.
W18 · PR comment chưa resolvePR review · developer⌄
YouThere’s one unresolved comment on your PR.
DeveloperOh, I thought I’d resolved everything.
YouNo problem. Could you check that comment before merging?
DeveloperSure, I’ll take a look now.
Useful chunks: on your PR · before merging · take a look
Tip: On for comment/review. Phrase tự nhiên, không đổ lỗi.
W19 · Giải thích in vs on PRADO review⌄
LeadIs the issue on the PR or in the code?
YouThe comment is on the PR, and the bug is in the code change.
LeadGot it. Can we fix it before approval?
YouYes, I’ll ask the developer to update the PR.
Useful chunks: comment on · bug in · Got it
Tip: Có thể nói bug in the PR theo nghĩa nằm trong changes.
W20 · Daily AI agent feedbackDaily with leader⌄
LeaderAny feedback on the agent today?
YouYes. I got feedback from X1 and EDI on the PR review skill.
LeaderDo we know what’s causing the issue?
YouNot yet. We’re checking the root cause with both teams. I’ll share an update when we know more.
Useful chunks: I got feedback · not yet · checking the root cause
Tip: Không tuyên bố root cause khi chưa xác nhận.
W21 · Một giờ daily có dài không?PMO + lead⌄
YouDo you think one hour is a bit too long for a daily meeting?
PMOMaybe. What would you suggest?
YouI think 30 minutes should be enough. We can follow up separately on detailed issues.
PMOThat sounds reasonable. Let’s try it next week.
Useful chunks: a bit too long · should be enough · follow up separately
Tip: Đưa đề xuất và phương án xử lý blockers, tránh chê meeting.
W22 · Hỏi lại khi không nghe rõFrench accent / Teams⌄
ManagerWe need to [unclear] the configuration first.
YouSorry, could you say the last part again?
ManagerWe need to check the configuration first.
YouGot it. I’ll check that and come back with an update.
Useful chunks: say the last part again · got it
Tip: Không cần “explain another way” nếu chỉ audio kém.
W23 · Hỏi chậm lạiTechnical call⌄
Developer[explains very quickly]
YouCould you speak a bit slower? I want to make sure I get the steps right.
DeveloperSure. First, we update the service connection.
YouOkay, then we rerun the pipeline, right?
Useful chunks: speak a bit slower · get the steps right
Tip: Nhẹ nhàng, rõ yêu cầu, không đổ lỗi accent.
W24 · Bạn hoàn thành task chưa?Standup⌄
PMOHave you finished the review?
YouI’ve finished the SonarQube part. I’m still checking the Snyk mapping.
PMOAny blockers?
YouNo blocker for now. I should have an update this afternoon.
Useful chunks: I’ve finished · still checking · no blocker
Tip: Present Perfect kết quả hiện tại; tiến độ ongoing dùng -ing.
W25 · Họp sáng nói việc hôm quaDaily standup⌄
LeaderWhat did you work on yesterday?
YouI reviewed the branch policies and checked the coverage gate.
LeaderWhat are you doing today?
YouI’m following up with the team on the remaining PR issues.
Useful chunks: worked on yesterday · I’m following up
Tip: Past Simple khi nói yesterday.
W26 · Coverage 0% không vội kết luậnSonarQube review⌄
PMOThe dashboard shows zero percent coverage. Is there no testing?
YouNot necessarily. We need to check whether the report was generated and imported.
PMOSo it might be a reporting gap?
YouExactly. I’ll verify the pipeline first.
Useful chunks: not necessarily · generated and imported · verify
Tip: 0% có thể do tests thiếu hoặc report/scan config; cần kiểm tra.
W27 · Snyk dependency issueSecurity review⌄
ManagerIs this vulnerability confirmed in our application?
YouSnyk reported it in a dependency. We still need to check the affected version and whether the code path is used.
ManagerWhat’s the next step?
YouI’ll ask the project lead to validate the impact and the available fix.
Useful chunks: reported · affected version · code path
Tip: Phân biệt finding với exploitability / impact.
W28 · Chia rõ owner follow-upPMO coordination⌄
PMOWho will follow up on the missing metrics?
YouThe project tech leads can check their pipelines. I can help them verify the SonarQube settings.
PMOCan we capture that in the action list?
YouYes, I’ll add the owners and next steps.
Useful chunks: follow up · owners · next steps
Tip: Không tự nhận toàn bộ công việc của team khác.
W29 · Báo issue chưa tái diễnManager update⌄
ManagerHas the pricing issue happened again?
YouWe haven’t seen another matching error since the last review.
ManagerSo is it fully resolved?
YouIt looks stable so far, but traffic has been limited. We’ll keep checking.
Useful chunks: haven’t seen · since · looks stable so far
Tip: Dùng Present Perfect với trạng thái kéo dài; không overclaim.
W30 · Apparently vs obviously trong troubleshootingIncident⌄
LeadIs the old endpoint still in use?
YouApparently, some requests were still going to the old endpoint.
LeadDo we know why?
YouNot yet. The logs show the errors, but they don’t confirm why the runtime used that endpoint.
Useful chunks: apparently · do not confirm why
Tip: Không dùng “obviously” khi root cause chưa đủ bằng chứng.
W31 · Đề xuất fix thay vì đổ lỗiDeveloper/architect⌄
ArchitectThe PR gate is still optional.
YouYes, I noticed that too. Could we review the branch policy together?
ArchitectSure, let’s check the inherited settings.
YouGreat. We can confirm which policy is actually blocking the merge.
Useful chunks: noticed that too · review together · actually
Tip: Đưa action rõ ràng, tôn trọng đồng nghiệp.
W32 · Cần đồng ý từ managerPlanning decision⌄
ManagerCan we roll this out to all teams next week?
YouTechnically, we can. But I’d suggest testing with two teams first.
ManagerWhy two teams?
YouThat gives us time to collect feedback and fix common issues.
Useful chunks: technically we can · I’d suggest · gives us time
Tip: Tách technical feasibility và risk management.
W33 · Xin phép phản biện trong meetingWith leaders⌄
LeaderI think we can skip the additional review.
YouI see your point. I have one concern about the production approval.
LeaderWhat’s the concern?
YouWe should make sure the right approver is configured before rollout.
Useful chunks: I see your point · one concern · make sure
Tip: Phản biện vào rủi ro, không phản đối cá nhân.
W34 · Khi leader hỏi targetManagement status⌄
GMAre we on track for the rollout?
YouWe’re on track overall. There’s one blocker related to access approval.
GMIs it critical?
YouIt may affect the timeline if it isn’t resolved by Thursday. We have a follow-up planned.
Useful chunks: on track · one blocker · may affect
Tip: Trả lời fact → impact → next step, không sa vào kỹ thuật.
W35 · Giải thích SonarQube vs Snyk ngắnGM lunch (light work)⌄
GMWhat are you focusing on this week?
YouMostly software quality and security checks across a few projects.
GMLike what?
YouSonarQube helps us track code quality and coverage. Snyk helps us spot dependency risks. We’re making sure the teams have good visibility.
Useful chunks: mostly · good visibility · across a few projects
Tip: Dừng ở high-level trừ khi GM muốn biết thêm.
W36 · Tóm tắt cuộc họpClosing meeting⌄
YouJust to summarize: we’ll check the missing metrics, confirm the owners, and share an update on Friday.
PMOSounds right.
YouAnything else before we wrap up?
PMONo, that covers it. Thanks everyone.
Useful chunks: just to summarize · anything else · wrap up
Tip: Tóm tắt 3 actions tối đa là đủ.
W37 · Hoãn Tech Office Hours không có topicDaily office hours⌄
YouHi everyone, any questions or blockers for today’s office hours?
DeveloperNothing from our side today.
YouOkay. If there are no other topics, we can skip today’s session.
DeveloperSounds good, thanks.
Useful chunks: no other topics · skip today’s session
Tip: Hủy meeting định kỳ lịch sự.
W38 · Sự cố permission approve pipelineADO governance⌄
DeveloperI can’t approve the production deployment.
YouOkay, let’s check whether you’re an authorized approver for that environment.
DeveloperIs it a pipeline permission?
YouIt may be an environment approval configuration. I’ll check the settings first.
Useful chunks: authorized approver · environment approval
Tip: Không nói chắc quyền cụ thể khi chưa kiểm tra.
W39 · VPN/network policy blockerCopilot issue⌄
ManagerDoes the Copilot issue affect everyone?
YouNot everyone. So far, we’ve mainly seen it with some Phase 1 users working from home.
ManagerDo we know if it’s a company policy?
YouNot yet. We’re comparing the network and policy settings.
Useful chunks: so far · we’ve mainly seen · comparing
Tip: Tránh khẳng định từ IT/Copilot khi chưa có evidence.
W40 · Đề xuất triển khai có kiểm soátRelease⌄
ArchitectWhy not deploy everything at once?
YouI’d prefer a gradual rollout. We can check the first group before moving on.
ArchitectWhat if we find an issue?
YouWe’ll pause the rollout and review the impact.
Useful chunks: gradual rollout · pause the rollout
Tip: Không phải always: nói rõ trade-off.
W41 · Hỏi cho rõ taskNew request from manager⌄
ManagerCan you review the security status?
YouSure. Do you want a high-level summary or a project-by-project review?
ManagerA short summary first.
YouGot it. I’ll focus on the main risks and next steps.
Useful chunks: high-level summary · main risks · next steps
Tip: Hỏi scope ngắn gọn, không truy vấn dài.
W42 · Chưa có đủ thông tinRisk update⌄
PMOIs the issue fixed?
YouI can’t confirm that yet. The latest test passed, but we need to check it under normal traffic.
PMOWhen can we review again?
YouLet’s review the logs after the next test run.
Useful chunks: can’t confirm yet · latest test passed · normal traffic
Tip: Phân biệt passed test với production fully resolved.
W43 · Dùng certainly & absolutely đúng chỗMeeting agreement⌄
ManagerCould you send me the summary today?
YouCertainly. I’ll send it after the meeting.
ManagerAnd do you agree with the proposed approach?
YouYes, absolutely. I think it’s a good starting point.
Useful chunks: Certainly (willingness) · absolutely (strong agreement)
Tip: Gắn mỗi trạng từ với speech act.
C06 · Cloud course — imminent shutdownTech lecture⌄
InstructorAn imminent shutdown triggers the termination flow.
YouSo the service is about to stop, and it needs to handle the current requests.
InstructorCorrect. It should stop accepting new work and drain the in-flight requests.
YouGot it. That helps avoid cutting requests off suddenly.
Useful chunks: imminent · drain in-flight requests · about to
Tip: Imminent = sắp xảy ra, thường dùng warning / impending event.
C07 · Cloud course — eventually consistentTech lecture⌄
InstructorThe update is eventually consistent.
YouSo different replicas may not show the same value right away?
InstructorExactly. They converge after some time.
YouOkay, so the result becomes consistent later.
Useful chunks: eventually consistent · converge · right away
Tip: Eventually ≠ maybe; nó nói về kết quả sau độ trễ.
C08 · Cloud course — retry and backoffTech lecture⌄
InstructorThe SDK gradually increases the backoff between retries.
YouSo it waits longer after each failed attempt?
InstructorYes, to avoid putting too much pressure on the service.
YouThat makes sense. It gives the service time to recover.
Useful chunks: gradually · backoff · put pressure on
Tip: Diễn đạt đơn giản để kiểm tra hiểu bài.
C09 · Cloud course — scale gracefullyTech lecture⌄
InstructorThe platform can gracefully shut down idle instances.
YouSo it stops taking new requests and lets the current ones finish first?
InstructorThat is the goal, within the allowed shutdown period.
YouRight. Then we still need to handle the timeout case.
Useful chunks: gracefully shut down · shutdown period · current ones
Tip: Giải thích cụ thể hơn thay vì chỉ dịch “êm”.
C10 · Cloud course — apparently vs clearlyTech lecture⌄
InstructorApparently, the client is reusing a stale DNS result.
YouSo that’s a possible explanation, not a confirmed root cause?
InstructorExactly. We need logs to verify it.
YouThen we can say the logs clearly show it, if the evidence supports that.
Useful chunks: apparently · clearly show · verify
Tip: Dùng trạng từ theo evidence.

Nhận test, không hứa chất lượng trước khi đo.
W03 · Xin logs từ developerTìm lỗi Azure App Service⌄
DeveloperThe pricing endpoint failed again after deployment.
YouCould you also share the logs for the affected time window?
DeveloperSure. Do you need anything else?
YouThe exact timestamp and correlation ID would help. Please remove any secrets first.
Chunks: affected time window · correlation ID · remove secrets
Xin relevant logs an toàn hơn xin toàn bộ dữ liệu.
W04 · Chỉ nghe không rõ phần ngàyManager người Pháp nói nhanh⌄
ManagerWe should move the rollout to the next platform window.
YouSorry, I missed the date. Could you say it one more time?
ManagerTuesday the third, at three.
YouTuesday the third at 3 PM. Vietnam time, right?
Chunks: missed the date · one more time · Vietnam time
Hỏi lại chi tiết thực sự bị thiếu.
W05 · Thảo luận PR commentPR còn comment chưa resolve⌄
DeveloperThe PR is ready to merge.
YouThere’s still one unresolved comment on the PR.
DeveloperI thought it was resolved.
YouCould you double-check the review thread before merging?
Chunks: on the PR · review thread · before merging
On the PR = comment/review gắn với PR.
W06 · SonarQube coverage chưa lên dashboardPMO hỏi trạng thái coverage⌄
PMOWhy is the coverage metric still missing?
YouWe can see the pipeline run, but the latest metric isn’t in the dashboard yet.
PMODo we know the reason?
YouNot yet. I’ll check the analysis settings and the report output.
Chunks: latest metric · report output
Nói rõ fact và unknown.
W07 · Snyk vulnerability cần xác minhLeader muốn biết có phải blocker⌄
LeaderIs this Snyk vulnerability blocking the release?
YouWe need to confirm the affected dependency and whether the vulnerable path is reachable.
LeaderCan you decide today?
YouI can give you an initial assessment today. The final decision needs the project owner.
Chunks: affected dependency · reachable path · assessment
Không tự khẳng định severity đồng nghĩa release blocker.
W08 · App config đổi nhưng lỗi tái diễnTách giả thuyết khỏi kết luận⌄
ManagerWas the wrong connection string the root cause?
YouIt looks like the old endpoint was still being used, but we haven’t confirmed why.
ManagerWhat is the next step?
YouI’ll compare the effective configuration and the logs from before and after deployment.
Chunks: it looks like · effective configuration
Đừng nói obviously khi root cause chưa xác nhận.
W09 · Pilot AI coding agentLeader hỏi rollout plan⌄
LeaderCan we roll this agent out to all teams?
YouI’d start with a small pilot and measure the results first.
LeaderWhat would you measure?
YouTime saved, review quality, rework, and cost. Then we can decide whether to scale.
Chunks: small pilot · time saved · rework
Gắn adoption với metric.
W10 · Chờ IT accessDeveloper bị policy chặn⌄
DeveloperI still can’t use the coding extension.
YouWe’re waiting for the IT policy review. In the meantime, could you try the approved workaround?
DeveloperIs that a permanent fix?
YouNo, it’s just for the time being until IT confirms the policy.
Chunks: in the meantime · approved workaround · for the time being
Không hướng dẫn bypass chính sách.
W11 · Xin hỗ trợ diagnosis DNSKiểm tra kết nối tên miền⌄
DeveloperThe API hostname doesn’t resolve from the server.
YouCould you send the exact hostname and the DNS error?
DeveloperI’ll share the output.
YouThanks. I’ll also check which DNS server the machine is using.
Chunks: doesn’t resolve · exact hostname · DNS server
Hỏi output trước khi kết luận DNS root cause.
W12 · AKS pod running but service downTránh coi Running = healthy⌄
DeveloperThe pod is Running, so Kubernetes looks fine.
YouThat’s one useful signal. Is it also Ready and handling requests?
DeveloperThe queue is still growing.
YouThen let’s check the worker logs and queue age.
Chunks: Running vs Ready · queue age
Tránh tranh luận quá chắc; dùng evidence.
W13 · Đề nghị review trước khi releasePMO hỏi có release hôm nay được không⌄
PMOCan we release today?
YouThe build passed, but we still need to test the rollback.
PMOCan we skip it this time?
YouI’d prefer not to. It’s an important safety check for production.
Chunks: build passed · test the rollback
Thách thức quyết định lịch sự.
W14 · Manager hỏi ETAChưa có đủ bằng chứng⌄
ManagerWhen will this be fixed?
YouI don’t have a reliable ETA yet.
ManagerCan you update us today?
YouYes. I can share the findings by 4 PM, even if the fix is still in progress.
Chunks: reliable ETA · findings · in progress
Phân biệt deadline cập nhật và deadline sửa xong.
W15 · Architect muốn scale nhanhCân nhắc giải pháp khác⌄
ArchitectAdding more replicas should fix the delay.
YouIt may help, but can we check the queue and external dependencies first?
ArchitectWhy do you think that matters?
YouCPU is low, so the bottleneck may be outside the worker.
Chunks: it may help · bottleneck · dependencies
Tập trung vào dữ liệu không phủ nhận thẳng.
W16 · Nối buổi ăn trưa sang công việcNói về work nhẹ nhàng với GM⌄
GMHave you tried this restaurant before?
YouYes, a few times. The grilled fish is really good.
GMNice. How’s your week going?
YouGood overall. We’re reviewing a few technical topics. Nothing urgent for lunch!
Chunks: a few times · good overall
Không biến lunch thành technical interrogation.
W17 · Café trước meetingTán gẫu và chốt giờ⌄
PMOHave you had coffee yet?
YouNot yet. I’ve been in meetings all morning.
PMOWant to grab one before the next call?
YouSure. We have about fifteen minutes, right?
Chunks: have coffee · all morning · before the next call
Present Perfect + đời sống.
W18 · Xin thêm context AI agentAI output không đúng kỳ vọng⌄
DeveloperThe coding agent generated the wrong PR description.
YouCould you share the prompt and one example of the output?
DeveloperI can share both.
YouGreat. Let’s compare them with the expected format before changing the skill.
Chunks: prompt · output · expected format
Hỏi cụ thể, tránh nói agent bị lỗi chung chung.
W19 · Azure Key Vault câu hỏi quyềnManager hỏi developer có cần quyền Key Vault không⌄
ManagerDo developers need Key Vault access to work locally?
YouNot always. It depends on how we handle local settings and secrets.
ManagerCan we avoid direct production access?
YouYes. We should use local development settings or approved access with least privilege.
Chunks: it depends · local settings · least privilege
Không phát biểu chung cho mọi môi trường.
W20 · Snyk không thấy dependencyKhoanh vùng thiếu dependency⌄
PMOWhy is this package missing from the Snyk view?
YouThe project was imported, but we need to check whether Snyk detected the manifest.
PMOCan you investigate?
YouYes, I can take a first look. Could you share the project link and last test time?
Chunks: manifest · take a first look · last test time
Phân biệt imported với dependency detected.
W21 · Manager ngắt lời để hỏi impactNói outcome trước technical detail⌄
YouThe pipeline policy has an optional quality gate.
GMWhat does that mean for delivery?
YouA PR could be merged without that check blocking it.
GMWhat do we need to do?
YouMake the gate required, then confirm it works on a test PR.
Chunks: optional quality gate · required gate
Đáp business impact ngắn gọn.
W22 · Chốt owner và actionCuối họp có nhiều người⌄
PMOAre we aligned on the next steps?
YouI think so. The tech lead will check the pipeline, and I’ll review the evidence.
PMOWhen will we follow up?
YouLet’s check again on Friday. I’ll post a short summary after this call.
Chunks: aligned · check again · post a summary
Chốt ai làm gì và mốc cụ thể.
W23 · Đề nghị giải thích một ví dụPhát biểu còn trừu tượng⌄
ArchitectThe service becomes more resilient under partial failure.
YouCould you give me one example of that failure case?
ArchitectFor example, when a downstream API times out.
YouGot it. So the service should fail gracefully without dropping the whole request?
Chunks: give me one example · downstream API
Khác với hỏi lại khi không nghe rõ.
W24 · Hai thay đổi diễn ra cùng lúcĐiều phối action đang chạy⌄
LeaderWhat are the teams doing while we wait for approval?
YouThe dev team is checking the PR. Meanwhile, I’m reviewing the deployment evidence.
LeaderAnd the production setup?
YouFor the time being, we’re keeping it unchanged.
Chunks: meanwhile · for the time being
Tập dùng đúng hai ý hành động và trạng thái.

09 / Meeting skills — Leaders, Managers, PMO, Developers

Phản xạ ngắn, trực tiếp, có bằng chứng. Bắt đầu bằng kết quả, rồi mới giải thích kỹ thuật khi được hỏi.

Who am I speaking to?

General ManagerOutcome → impact → next step

We’re on track overall. One access issue may delay the rollout. We’re following up today.

Không đi sâu config nếu họ chưa yêu cầu.
Manager / LeaderStatus → risk → decision

We’ve completed the review. The main risk is the optional PR gate. Could we agree on an owner?

Nhắm quyết định rõ.
PMOScope → owner → target

The missing metrics affect three projects. The tech leads will check the pipelines, and I’ll support the review.

Gắn action với owner.
DeveloperEvidence → question → help

I saw one unresolved comment on the PR. Could you take a look? I can help check the pipeline if needed.

Tránh đổ lỗi.
ArchitectTrade-off → proposal → verification

That can work, but it increases risk. I’d suggest trying it with one service first.

Phản biện technical có lập luận.

28 reusable meeting lines — short, easy to say

IntentSentenceCopy / Listen
Bắt đầu meetingShall we get started?
Mời cập nhậtCould you give us a quick update?
Xác nhậnJust to make sure I understood...
Xin nhắc lạiSorry, could you say that again?
Nói chậmCould you speak a bit slower?
Đồng ýYes, good point.
Đồng ý mạnhAbsolutely, that makes sense.
Nhận lờiCertainly, I can check that.
Sửa thông tinActually, the issue was in Dev, not Prod.
Phỏng đoánIt looks like a configuration issue.
Thiếu evidenceWe can’t confirm the root cause yet.
Phản biệnI see your point, but I have one concern.
Cắt ngang lịch sựSorry to interrupt, but can I clarify one thing?
Ưu tiênI think we should focus on the blocker first.
Đề xuấtMaybe we can try this approach first.
Gắn ownerWho can take ownership of this?
DeadlineCould we have an update by Friday?
Xin ví dụCould you give me a quick example?
Tóm tắtJust to summarize, we have three actions.
Kết thúcIf there’s nothing else, let’s wrap up here.
Xin chờLet me check that and get back to you.
Rõ giới hạnSo far, we’ve only seen the issue in Dev.
Nhấn tiến độWe’ve made good progress this week.
Đề xuất họp ngắnI think 30 minutes should be enough for our daily meeting.
Đồng ý scopeThat works for me.
Đưa câu hỏiCan I ask a quick question?
Thay đổi topicBefore we move on, one quick point.
Không cần meetingIf there are no topics, we can skip today’s session.

Meeting life cycle — câu phù hợp từng giai đoạn

00–05 · Open

“Shall we get started?”
“Any quick updates?”

05–15 · Align

“Just to clarify...”
“So the main issue is...”

15–25 · Decide

“I’d suggest...”
“Who can own this?”

25–30 · Close

“To summarize...”
“Let’s wrap up.”

Timeline minh họa một cuộc họp 30 phút, không phải quy định cố định.

09B / Meeting Fluency Lab — câu ngắn để tương tác tự nhiên

V5 bổ sung: phân biệt in the meantime / for the time being, đề nghị thử việc, xin logs/evidence, hỏi lại, báo cáo và chốt action. 70 mẫu có 3 cấp độ Natural / Simpler / Professional; lọc, copy, nghe, luyện phản xạ.

Mental model 01 · During vs temporary

In the meantime ≠ For the time being

DURING THE WAIT

In the meantime

Trong lúc chờ — làm việc khác trong cùng khoảng thời gian.

We're waiting for the security review. In the meantime, we can check the test results.

Tương tự meanwhile, nhưng nhấn vào khoảng chờ và một việc xen vào.

TEMPORARY STATE

For the time being

Tạm thời, trước mắt — giữ trạng thái/giải pháp hiện tại cho đến khi có thay đổi.

For the time being, let's keep the current version in production.

Trong cuộc họp, for now thường ngắn, dễ nói và tự nhiên hơn.

NOW · Request pendingApproval chưa có
IN THE MEANTIMEReview logs / tests
AFTER APPROVALDecide / deploy

Ghi nhớ: Meanwhile = đồng thời / trong khi đó; until then = cho đến mốc đã đề cập; at the moment = hiện tại; by then = trước hoặc chậm nhất vào mốc đó. Viết đúng là in the meantime (một từ “meantime”).

Mental model 02 · Offer vs promise

I can give it a try.

“Mình có thể thử.” Khi muốn chủ động nhận kiểm tra nhưng chưa chắc kết quả.

I can give it a try with one project first and share the results.

Đừng hứa I can fix it today khi mới có thể thử điều tra.

Could you also share the logs?

“Bạn gửi thêm logs được không?” Câu gốc bạn đưa đúng và tự nhiên.

Could you also share the relevant logs and timestamps so we can investigate further?

Với log thực tế: chỉ xin phần cần thiết; cần timestamp/time zone, correlation ID và che credentials/token trước khi gửi.

Reusable phrase bank · Natural by default

Mẫu câu dùng ngay trong meeting

Chọn bối cảnh rồi chuyển Natural / Simpler / Professional; chỉ hiển thị một phiên bản mỗi lúc.
